Operations Research Developer
Dallas, TX
Full-time
Onsite
Entry Level
$132K/yr - $147K/yr
Southwest Airlines is hiring an Operations Research Developer to turn operational challenges into mathematical models and scalable decision-support solutions. The role develops, tests, refines, and supports optimization applications in collaboration with operations stakeholders, technology teams, and business customers.
Airlines/Aviation
No H1B
Responsibilities
Support the develop mathematical models based on business requirements
Assist in developing solution strategies to solve models developed by the Team
Develop code to implement solution strategies under the guidance of more-experienced Team members
Assist in preparing technical documentation of models and solution strategies
Participate in reviews of models, solution strategies, and code with the Team
Assist in testing applications to insure they perform as expected, and solve the correct problem
Participate in reviews of solutions with business Customers to ensure that they are acceptable
Assist in calibrating the model or solution strategy as needed
Work effectively with the rest of the Team, Business Customers, Technology development Teams, and support groups
Support developed applications as needed with guidance from more-experienced Team members
Assist with enhancements or recalibration as the business problem changes
Seek guidance from more-experienced Team members as appropriate
Must be able to meet any physical ability requirements listed on this description
May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders
Qualification
Linear and Integer Programming (LP/IP)
Software Development
Programming
Operations Research
Optimization
Mathematical Modeling
SAS

R
C++
Statistical Modeling
Airline Operations Optimization
Required
Basic knowledge of a modern programming language
Basic knowledge of software development, practice, concepts, and technology obtained through college degree program, formal training and or work experience
Demonstrates basic optimization aptitude and ability for logical and abstract thinking
Focus on partnering and communication when interacting with business Customers and technology development and support groups
Ability to design basic solutions, write code, perform testing, create documentation, and implement optimization projects
Ability to analyze and resolve basic problems
Ability to work effectively in a strong Customer service/team oriented environment
Required: High School Diploma or GED
Experience using LP/IP tools in an academic environment
Software development experience in an academic environment
Ability to communicate and interact with others in the English language to meet the demands of the job
Must be a U.S. citizen or have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986
Preferred
Preferred: Experience applying operations research principles, methodologies, and analytical techniques to solve complex transportation, logistics, or operational business challenges
Preferred prior academic or business experience applying optimization methods in an airline environment
Preferred training or experience using SAS, SPSS, R, or similar statistical tools to create statistical models
Preferred C++ coding experience
Benefits
For eligible Leadership and individual contributor roles, additional bonus opportunities are available and awarded at the discretion of the company.
Fly for free, as a privilege, on any open seat on all Southwest flights (your eligible dependents too)
Southwest will help fund your 401(k) retirement savings with Company contributions up to 9.3% of your eligible earnings
Potential for annual ProfitSharing contribution in the Southwest Retirement Savings Plan—when Southwest profits, you profit; contributions are made at the discretion of the Company and are subject to the Retirement Savings Plan vesting schedule.
Competitive health insurance for you and your eligible dependents (including pets)
Southwest offers health plan coverage options that start from the very first day of employment. You will have 30 days to select and enroll in your health plan with coverage retroactively available to your first day of employment.
